See compatibility changes."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An **enhanced version of a Codex-style side chat** for

row)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"On top of the Codex-style base, it adds one extra capability: when the main

its options **without interrupting the flow**"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" — let the AI help you think it
through first, then bring the answer back and answer the dialog."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> 中文文档见 README.zh.md."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Select text → ask in a side chat.** Select any part of a message and a
floating button *"Ask in "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"side chat"* appears. The selected text is carried
into the side chat automatically.
- **Per-conversa"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"tion isolation.** Each side chat is a hidden ordinary DSH
session (`meta.parentSession` links it to "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"the conversation that started it,
and the session is archived so it stays out of the main session li"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"st).
DSH 0.1.7 refuses a model step to an archived session, so the archive is
lifted for exactly as "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"long as a side-chat turn is running and restored when
it settles. A host-created session is never ac"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"counted to a Workspace, so even
in that window it can only surface under the sidebar's *Ungrouped* b"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ucket,
never under the workspace it was started from.
Every conversation gets its own side chat.
- *"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"*Inherits main-conversation context.** The side chat is aware of the
conversation it was started fro"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"m and its working directory, and inherits the
main conversation's toolset, model, thinking effort, a"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"nd permission preset by
default — so it can act on the same workspace as the main conversation.
- **"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"Model / effort / permission are adjustable.** A two-level model menu
(provider → model → effort) and"},{"id":"p8s13","text":" a permission menu are copied from the main
conversation, so each side chat can be tuned independent"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ly.
- **"Look up workspace / parent when needed" switch** (default off). When on,
the side chat may "},{"id":"p8s15","text":"read files from the workspace and the parent conversation
when it needs more information.
- **Normal"},{"id":"p8s16","text":" conversation capabilities.** Markdown replies, thinking/reasoning
display, image attachments (paste"},{"id":"p8s17","text":" / drag-and-drop), send/stop controls, and
thinking-duration display — all reuse the same UI primiti"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"ves as the main
conversation.
- **Bring AI replies back to the main conversation.** Every assistant "},{"id":"p8s19","text":"reply in
the side chat can be brought into the current main conversation: select part
of it with the"},{"id":"p8s20","text":" mouse, or insert the whole reply in one click. Either way you
can choose **"Insert directly"** (ver"},{"id":"p8s21","text":"batim) or **"Summarize & insert"** (the

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Codex-style side chat, enhanced"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This plugin is an **enhanced version of a Codex-style side chat**: a second,
agentic chat that works"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" beside the main conversation — plus an extra capability
on top of the Codex-style base: side-chatti"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ng about the current **question
dialog** without interrupting the flow."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Node.js ≥ 20
- pnpm
- DSH `0.2.1-rc.1` or newer. The declared window is the open range
`>=0.2.1-rc"},{"id":"p13s2","text":".1`: DSH validates peer ranges with `includePrerelease`, so that
prerelease and every later version "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"are inside it (a caret or an exact pin
locks newer runtimes out — see AGENTS.md). The floor moved to"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"
`0.2.1-rc.1` with 0.5.0 because that release changed the `/api` trust fence
this plugin mirrors (li"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"stener bind literals, protocol-normalized ports, and
`trustedHosts` resolved from `webStartup`).
- `"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"pnpm build` ends with `check-seed-exports`, which compares the client
bundle's frozen-module-table i"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"mports against a real DSH install. Set
`DSH_INSTALL` (or pass `--shell`) when the install is not dis"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"coverable via
`dsh` on `PATH`; without a target the check skips instead of failing.
- It then runs `"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"check-dsh-compat` (also available as `pnpm check:dsh`): every
`@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer must be a sin"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"gle open lower bound `>=<floor>`, all
peers must share one floor, that floor must match `dsh.plugin."},{"id":"p13s11","text":"json`'s
`engines.dsh`, and it must not be newer than the DSH runtime under test.
- `pnpm verify:line"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"s` (`scripts/verify-dsh-lines.mjs`) runs the whole suite against
**both** the pinned development lin"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"e and the declared peer floor — swapping the
manifest, aligning `cordis`/`schemastery` to each line'"},{"id":"p13s14","text":"s own manifest, then
restoring everything. CI runs the floor line on every push."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Forward compatibility is the design rule behind that window.** The peers carry
no upper bound, so "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"any later DSH (0.2.2-rc.1, 0.2.3, 0.3.0, …) installs without a
manifest change; the host half then p"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"robes runtime capabilities (`AgentModel` →
durable model selection, otherwise the 0.2.1 coupler) ins"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"tead of comparing version
numbers, and the client half is guarded by `check-seed-exports` at build t"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ime
plus a render boundary at runtime. Forward compatibility is not a claim about
unknown future beh"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"avior: install-time acceptance is guaranteed by the open range,
and run-time behavior is re-verified"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" against each new line with `pnpm verify:lines`."}],"truncated":true}
